## Nocci 0.3.1
A small update that makes Nocci's wording clearer and more consistent. Nothing about how it works has changed, and your settings stay as they are.
- **Claude Code setup reads correctly in every state.** If your status line was removed after setup, Nocci now says so plainly, and its buttons say exactly what they will do. A setup that is already complete no longer points at a button you cannot press. - **Sessions:** reinstalling the hooks after moving Nocci now says Reinstall throughout. - **Settings** describe what each option does more precisely, including the small mark above each bar that Pace adds. - **Menus and messages** use one consistent style.
Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
